t: You're on Queen Anne Street, in front of number 58, an ordinary building in Westminster. It matters here because Sybil Fane, Countess of Westmorland, died in this house. Born Lady Sybil St Clair-Erskine, she was a British aristocrat and socialite, and she lived from 1871 to 1910. She was only in her late thirties when she died. The material I have doesn't say much more about her time here, so I'll leave it there. Take a moment to picture the street as a place where society lives were lived.
